summary.text: Expanding Night Sky is Qing Ye's signature immortal battlefield killer move. It keeps growing in size and range, with no limit in theory.

claims.text: Pressed by Ba Shi Ba’s consecutive profound-light hits, Qing Ye activates an immortal killer move. His figure vanishes and turns into darkness. In the sky it is like a blob of ink landing in water and expanding endlessly. Ba Shi Ba hesitates and identifies it as Qing Ye’s signature killer move. Both sides already have a certain level of information about each other. Normal immortal battlefields are formed after some preparation. Given enough time, Qing Ye could spread this immortal battlefield to cover the whole of white heaven. Ba Shi Ba flies backwards at once. If he went in, his rule path would be weakened by the dark path environment. A moment later Frost Dragon Manor appears among reinforcing Immortal Gu Houses and attacks him. He cannot destroy the house in a short time. He then retreats and pulls distance so expanding night sky will not trap him.
